policy.capture_limitation: Historical local sanitized policy capture; no claim of current or historical financial owner authority beyond documented time bounds.

missing_proof: Fresh HTTPS closed-bar parity and actual next-open available within each original entry window
Historical bid/ask/last quote and <=10bps reference-drift/stop-TP1 untouched interval proof
Historical instrument lot/tick/minimum/market maximum plus funding interval/cap and account-specific fee captures
Historical complete account positions/orders/one-way mode/available balance and risk/loss/cooldown/claim state
Exact first SOURCE_BLOCKED observation timestamp; current archive count cannot backdate it
Executed orders, fills, terminal fees and net outcome are not established and were not requested or read
sizing_contract: Frozen V1 actual next-open reference; 4x stop distance; TP1/TP2 40/60, 168h max hold; quantity multiple of 5*qtyStep, per-leg minimum, minimum notional, max market size, 1USDT stop-plus-cost stress, 30USDT gross, 50 allocation including 20 reserve. Historical raw signal entry/48-bar stop/three targets are producer fields, not the V1 execution plan.
coverage_interpretation: Absent or empty publication index is UNKNOWN_SOURCE_COVERAGE, not a full-hour NO_SIGNAL assertion. Receipt census alone is insufficient without matching exact rows, scope, source pins and timeliness. Existing NO_NEW_SIGNAL means no eligible candidate on that tick only.
scope_interpretation: All five publication times fall within recorded scope timestamps. This is necessary time compatibility, not historical unspent owner GO/claim or free capital. max_entries=1 and max_positions=1 preclude treating five raw signals as five independent permitted trades.
same_hour_competition: XPLUSDT was published 22.220s before ESPUSDT. If both otherwise eligible in one candidate tick, existing first_observed_ms/symbol/id sorting selects XPLUSDT first; no historical admission or eventual second trade inferred.
prefix_check_method: SHA256 canonical JSON list of journal event payloads strictly before signal bar, matching WarmIntake.prefix. Initial raw JSONL-byte comparison was methodologically inapplicable and superseded.
publication_timestamp_semantics: Existing source code samples publication_completed_ms after original observation publication but before index publication. Delays prove recorded original observation completion, not completion of the later publication index or full-hour receipt fsync. No mtime or later receipt timestamp substituted.
